components.name: Ink Button
components.description: Default commit action: full ink pill.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ink { background: var(--ink, #1e1b16); color: #fff; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #1e1b16); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Verdict Pair
components.description: Vale and No cuenta buttons shown together on a partner post.
components.css: .ds-verdict { display: flex; gap: 10px; } .ds-vbtn { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); flex: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-vbtn-vale { background: var(--vale, #2f9e57); color: #fff; } .ds-vbtn-no { background: #fff; color: var(--nocuenta, #d93a26); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--nocuenta, #d93a26); } .ds-vbtn:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-vbtn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #1e1b16); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Soft Button
components.description: Secondary and cancel actions on Canvas.
components.css: .ds-btn-soft { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--canvas, #f4f3ef); color: var(--ink, #1e1b16); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 750; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-soft:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-soft:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #1e1b16); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Canvas field that turns white with an ink ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; gap: 7px; } .ds-field > span { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; font-stretch: 80%; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-2, #5f5a52); } .ds-input { font: inherit; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 17px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--canvas, #f4f3ef); color: var(--ink, #1e1b16); outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px transparent; transition: box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 0.18s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-3, #8a847a); } .ds-input:focus { background: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--ink, #1e1b16); }

components.name: Crate Label
components.description: Meal-kind tag: narrow caps on solid crate colour.
components.html: FrutaVerduraLas dos
components.css: .ds-crates { display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-crate { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 850; font-stretch: 72%; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #fff; } .ds-crate-fruta { background: #e8432e; } .ds-crate-verdura { background: var(--vale, #2f9e57); } .ds-crate-ambas { background: #f27a1f; }

components.name: Score Placard
components.description: Fluo price placard hanging on two strings: points and streak.
components.html: 5ptsRacha 2
components.css: .ds-placard-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; margin-top: 40px; transform-origin: 50% -40px; transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-placard-wrap:hover { transform: rotate(4deg); } .ds-placard-wrap::before, .ds-placard-wrap::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -40px; width: 2px; height: 44px; background: #1e1b16; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-placard-wrap::before { left: 18%; } .ds-placard-wrap::after { right: 18%; } .ds-placard { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); min-width: 132px; padding: 10px 14px 11px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--fluo, #ffe14a); color: var(--fluo-ink, #3a3000); box-shadow: 0 2px 3px rgba(30,27,22,0.12), 0 12px 20px -12px rgba(30,27,22,0.4); display: grid; justify-items: center; } .ds-placard-num { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px; font-weight: 900; font-stretch: 62%; line-height: 0.82; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-digits { font-size: 72px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-unit { font-size: 18px; font-stretch: 75%; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-streak { margin-top: 6px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; }

components.name: Valance
components.description: Striped scalloped awning edge under every section title, in the viewer colour.
components.css: .ds-valance { width: 320px; height: 22px; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--stripe, #1e1b16) 0 14px, #fff 14px 28px); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 15px, #0000 15px), radial-gradient(7px at 7px 15px, #000 98%, #0000) 0 0 / 14px 100% repeat-x; mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 15px, #0000 15px), radial-gradient(7px at 7px 15px, #000 98%, #0000) 0 0 / 14px 100% repeat-x; box-shadow: inset 0 4px 0 #1e1b16, inset 0 6px 0 rgba(30,27,22,0.08); filter: drop-shadow(0 3px 3px rgba(30,27,22,0.12)); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Canvas pill track with a sliding white thumb.
components.css: .ds-seg { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: flex; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--canvas, #f4f3ef); width: 300px; } .ds-seg button { font: inherit; flex: 1; min-height: 42px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-2, #5f5a52); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s, background 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--ink, #1e1b16); } .ds-seg button[aria-checked="true"] { background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #1e1b16); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(30,27,22,0.06), 0 6px 18px -10px rgba(30,27,22,0.22); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #1e1b16); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Blurred white bar, four tabs and a raised fluo upload button; active tab gets an ink marker.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); align-items: start; width: 375px; height: 72px; padding: 0 6px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(1.6); box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 var(--line, #e6e3dc); } .ds-tab { font: inherit; position: relative; border: 0; background: none; padding: 30px 0 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 750; color: var(--ink-2, #5f5a52); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab.on { color: var(--ink, #1e1b16); } .ds-tab i { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; margin-left: -13px; width: 26px; height: 4px; border-radius: 0 0 4px 4px; background: var(--ink, #1e1b16); } .ds-fab { justify-self: center; width: 60px; height: 60px; margin-top: -14px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--fluo, #ffe14a); color: var(--fluo-ink, #3a3000); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(30,27,22,0.12), 0 14px 26px -12px rgba(30,27,22,0.55); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-fab svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; } .ds-fab:active { transform: scale(0.9) rotate(-4deg); } .ds-tab:focus-visible, .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #1e1b16); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Brote is a street market with exactly two stalls. Each partner owns one: a scalloped, striped awning in their avatar colour, their living avatar under it, and a fluorescent yellow price placard hanging on two strings that carries their points and streak. The score is not a chart; it is the market itself. Whoever leads tints the whole top band with their colour, and a tie drops it to a neutral grey canvas. Every other screen inherits the market through a striped valance under its title, crate-label tags for meal kinds, and placard-yellow price tags in the store.

The ground is plain white and the ink is a warm near-black; everything loud in the system is either a player's colour, placard fluo, or a verdict colour. Type is a single variable family, Archivo, pushed narrow and heavy for anything that names or counts (titles, numerals, tags) and left at normal width for reading. Surfaces are soft and rounded, lifted with warm, low shadows; buttons are full pills. Density is phone-first and generous: 16px gutters, 52px controls, one column.

Motion is part of the material, not decoration. Awnings unroll once on open, placards swing on their strings when points change, numerals roll, sheets ride a spring, and the active tab marker slides between tabs. All of it runs through Motion with `reducedMotion="user"`, so reduced-motion users get state without travel.
keyCharacteristics: Two player colours drive awnings, valances and the leader band; the system has no fixed brand hue beyond ink and fluo.
Fluorescent yellow placard paper with condensed, 900-weight Archivo numerals is the signature object.
Light only: white ground, warm canvas sections, warm ink.
Narrow uppercase Archivo for names and counts; normal-width Archivo for reading.
Pill buttons, rounded cards, warm soft shadows, Phosphor bold icons.
Smooth spring motion everywhere, honouring reduced-motion preferences.

rules.name: The Players Own the Colour Rule
rules.body: Identity colour comes only from the two avatar colours. A surface that needs a player hue reads it from that player's avatar, never from a fixed accent.

rules.name: The Fluo Is Paper Rule
rules.body: Fluo is the placard material. It marks the score, prices and the act of posting; it is never a generic highlight, and its text is always Placard Ink.

rules.name: The Verdict Pair Rule
rules.body: Vale Green and No Cuenta Red mean "counts" and "doesn't count" (plus success and error). Do not borrow them for decoration.

rules.name: The Narrow Means Signage Rule
rules.body: Narrow widths (62 to 80%) and uppercase are for things that name or count: titles, numerals, tags, stamps, stall names. Reading text stays at normal width and sentence case.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every changing number (points, steppers, codes, schedules) uses tabular numerals so values roll and align without jitter.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted with Warm Ink and has a negative spread on its long layer, so objects feel lifted off paper rather than outlined.

dos: **Do** take every identity colour from the players' avatar colours, and tint the top band with the leader's colour at 20% into white (tie: Tie Grey).
**Do** put scores, prices and the upload action on Placard Fluo with Placard Ink text and condensed 900-weight Archivo numerals.
**Do** open every section screen with an uppercase 30px headline followed by the striped valance in the viewer's colour.
**Do** use Phosphor icons from react-icons/pi in the bold weight, switching to the fill variant only for the active tab and for status glyphs (flame, crown, check, warning).
**Do** animate with Motion using the shared tokens: ease-out cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), spring 420/34 for UI state, press scale 0.96, and keep MotionConfig reducedMotion="user".
**Do** use tabular numerals for every number that changes.
donts: **Don't** add a dark theme or dark surfaces beyond Warm Ink controls; the system is light only.
**Don't** use emojis anywhere; meal kinds, verdicts and status use Phosphor icons and crate labels.
**Don't** add taglines, kickers or explanatory footnotes above or below titles.
**Don't** show score as progress rings or charts on grey cards; the score lives on placards under awnings.
**Don't** use Ink Three for small text; it is for icons, placeholders and borders.
**Don't** use Vale Green or No Cuenta Red for anything but the verdicts, success and errors.
**Don't** use grey or hard-offset shadows; shadows are warm, soft and spread negatively.
